example.title: St. Peter's Episcopal Church, Rock & Main Streets

brief: Small stone Gothic Revival church of 1853: a steep-roofed nave of rubble stone with lancet windows, a square front tower with a slender wooden spire, and a plain white interior with a raised chancel.
